items.item: 1. astra's high finding: closure read across all steps said as costs returning in time
items.how: Re-said wherever the canonical sentence stood in my files: the English screen, README-ZH, USES In brief and its Chinese, the one page and its Chinese, the overview's section 7 (en and zh) and 08 section 2. English: 'where relations of being affected close, read across all steps, whatever bears the costs of its course lies within what can, at some remove, affect its own going on, and whether and when those costs come back to it in time is part of the dynamics ([07 §4.11](...#condition-in-time))'; the one-way clause kept. I wrote 'whatever bears the costs ... lies within' rather than 'what its course costs others lies within', since the closure of `AffectedBy` holds formations, those that can affect the life, not costs; under `MutuallyDependent` every formation lies within it, so the sentence is exact, and LatePair is why it says nothing of return in time. Chinese: '“受影响”的关系闭合之处（这里把各个时刻的依赖与交换合在同一个关系里读），为它的进程付出代价的东西，都在能隔着若干环节影响它自身延续的东西之内，但这并不保证影响按时间顺序传回来，代价是否、何时回到它身上，是动力学的一部分（07 §4.11）'. The overview's Chinese uses its own term （跨越所有步来读） there. The glossaries and MAP did not restate this sentence (GLOSSARY's condition row already says 'read across all steps (depending and exchanging each at some step, in either order)'), so they were left.

items.item: 6. astra: the lock summary takes Accrues
items.how: USES: 'once locked stays locked whatever loss it does not read; if that loss grows by at least one unit each step, it passes every bound without breaking the lock: for any type, without noise'. The one page's and the overview's 'What it is' / lead (which said 'stays locked while a loss nothing in it reads passes every bound'): 'stays locked whatever loss nothing in it reads, and if that loss grows by at least one unit each step, it passes every bound without breaking the lock'. Chinese likewise (不论……如何；若这一损失每一步至少增加一个单位，它会超过任何界限，而锁定不被打破). The lock alone holds for any loss (`join_course`, `locked_stays`); passing every bound is `loss_grows` under `Accrues`, which `lock_outlives_loss` takes. The screens' 'a locked start stays locked however large an unread loss grows' was already exact and is unchanged.
